caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object centered against a plain, light beige background. The object is a brown and golden-toned decorative piece with the upper portion featuring a sculpted sphinx-like figure, having a human face and a lion's body, resting on top of a rounded, bowl-shaped element that is adorned with a jagged edge. Below the bowl, a symmetrical, curved motif resembling braided ropes or garlands extends downward and joins at a smaller ornamental section at the base. There is a signature "W. L. Antolini" in small, reddish-brown handwritten text to the right of the object near the bottom. The overall color palette consists of earthy browns, golds, and warm tones.
title: Door Knocker
